summary_en: 150,000 shares (1.46% of 10.26M ex-treasury); ¥500M ceiling; open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange; execution window 15 June 2026 – 31 March 2027; stated rationale: shareholder returns, capital efficiency, and stock-based incentive grants.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares (Treasury Share Acquisition Based on Articles of Incorporation Provisions under Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 12 June 2026, Yossix Holdings' board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 150,000 shares (1.46% of the 10.26 million shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥500 million. Purchases will take place on the Tokyo Stock Exchange via open-market transactions between 15 June 2026 and 31 March 2027. The company intends to use acquired shares for stock-based employee incentive grants and to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency. As of 31 March 2026, the company held 104,840 treasury shares.
